## 1.0.0 (2026-11-05)

### ✨ New Features

* Add SmartNews patches, standalone build pipeline, and update project metadata ([a8b89bc](https://github.com/haukist/morphe-patches-smartnews/commit/a8b89bc17880241c32624cbc2230cea014b3c8ef))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* skip E2E patch test in CI environments when target APKS is missing ([8e78a6e](https://github.com/haukist/morphe-patches-smartnews/commit/8e78a6e6cf8106c1207531d2d1161c37f7b19abf))

patches.name: Direct article share URL
patches.description: Shares and copies the original article URL directly instead of SmartNews tracking redirect links (l.smartnews.com).

patches.name: Disable ads and trackers
patches.description: Disables first-party and third-party advertisements, analytics, and tracking SDKs in SmartNews.

patches.name: Popup share menu
patches.description: Replaces the top-right custom share bottom sheet with the compact PopupMenu used in web mode.
